source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Create a folder:
$ mkdir /tmp/mst

2. Mount MLNX-ISO:
$ mount MLNX_Packages/MLNX_OFED_LINUX-5.8-1.1.2.1-ubuntu22.04-x86_64.iso /tmp/mst

3. Install MLNX-Driver:
$ cd /tmp/mst 
$ yes | ./mlnxofedinstall --force

4. Power-cycle SUT in order to enable the setting:
$ reboot

5. Check MLNX devices:
$ mst start
$ mst status -v

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Install MLNX-Driver without errors.
2. After MLNX-Driver installation completes, MLNX devices can be checked.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Fixed ISO, `yes | mlnxofedinstall --force`, truncated output and reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes package/reboot risk but uses fixed/forced install, truncated evidence and no compatibility/rollback gates.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds ISO hash/kernel support, device/traffic state, full transcript, OOB and rollback.

original_test_intent: Install the specified or project-approved MLNX_OFED driver on the compatible Ubuntu/kernel host, activate it through the approved restart method, and verify Mellanox devices through mst without installer or platform errors.
original_method: Validate and mount the exact ISO, run the reviewed installer options with complete output, perform the source-required activation transition after clarifying reboot versus power-cycle wording, then verify installed packages/modules, mst devices, links and logs.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies/approves the package, traffic window, activation method and recovery. No physical or visual core is inherent once that plan is fixed; install, restart and evidence collection can be automated.
required_inputs: MLNX_OFED ISO/version/hash and supported Ubuntu/kernel/architecture matrix
Mellanox PCIe/FRU identity, current modules, links and active traffic
Installer options and decision on whether `--force`/noninteractive responses are approved
Case-specific decision whether source requires warm reboot or true power-cycle
OOB, rollback package/image and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Do not use fixed ISO or `yes | --force` until artifact, compatibility and every prompt effect are reviewed.
Quiesce approved traffic and maintain independent OOB before driver replacement.
Capture full installer output; never truncate to the last 20 lines.
Stop on kernel/dependency/signature/device mismatch or uncertain install state.
No automatic reinstall, uninstall, reboot/power-cycle retry or rollback.
agent_execution_scope: Mount and run the approved installer while retaining full stdout/stderr/exit/package changes.
Perform exactly the owner-selected activation transition and monitor return through OOB.
Verify package/module/mst/device/link/log state and report Tool Result only.
engineer_actions: Approve artifact/options/traffic window/recovery and resolve reboot versus power-cycle.
Review any unexpected installer prompt or activation failure.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe as a generic command: fixed path/version, unreviewed force/yes, shell quoting/mount assumptions and truncated output hide failure context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source ISO/mount/installer/mst workflow but parameterize only from an approved manifest, preserve the complete log and avoid force unless explicitly required.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ISO 5.8-1.1.2.1 Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64, `/tmp/mst`, installer, activation, mst checks and 30/30-minute fields are preserved as source values.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a manifest with ISO digest, kernel matrix, reviewed response/options, pre/post package/module/link inventory and OOB-monitored activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record ISO/install-script commit, OFED packages, kernel, adapter firmware, BIOS/BMC.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA MLNX_OFED installation/support documentation and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance, compatibility, full evidence and rollback gates without replacing MLNX_OFED/mst.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Installer success alone does not prove modules, links or traffic recovered.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a newer compatible ISO/options and a specific activation method; the report must name them and cannot claim the fixed source package/method was executed if overridden.
expected_evidence: ISO hash/compatibility, device/module/link/traffic pre-state and approval
Complete mount/installer/package transcript and exit codes
OOB-monitored activation timeline and post-boot package/module/mst/link inventory
BMC/SEL/OS events, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure labels step 4 a `Power-cycle` but gives `$ reboot`, which is a warm restart and not equivalent to removal/restoration of power. The owner must select the required activation semantics without silently rewriting the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Installation intent and both possible activation methods are understood. The decision is a readiness item; review and approved automated execution can proceed once selected.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the native install flow but rejects forced/truncated execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all compatibility/OOB safeguards and corrects classification: package and approval do not make an automatable flow partial.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Surfaces warm-reboot versus power-cycle conflict and separates Tool Result from verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents blind network-stack replacement, preserves complete failure evidence and avoids claiming a reboot as a physical power cycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core installer, activation and verification operations can be orchestrated through approved machine interfaces. Risk and supplied media affect readiness, not automation classification.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code repository search including source script URL

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat installation, activation, rollback or reboot automatically after any failure or uncertain state.
